description: Frozen fingerprint of the permanent Vocalis base voice. The base voice is the recorded CMU ARCTIC source material and its unit index. It is never removed, never replaced, and never re-derived by destructive edits. New capability is added around it. scripts/check_base_voice.mjs verifies this file on demand.

policy.improvementLocation: surrounding technology only: text analysis, pronunciation, prosody, unit selection, join smoothing, pitch/duration modification, accent modelling, playback, export, evaluation
policy.thirdPartyDataAllowed: only the licensed base voice recordings listed here, with their retained copyright notices
